name: 公平鸽
description: 第一、绝对不放过任何争执！第二、绝对不能因为睡过头晚到现场！第三、绝对要公正裁判！第四、绝对要在被双方驱逐之前做出判决。——《公平鸽的守则》
descriptionEn: First, never let any dispute go unattended! Second, never be late to the scene because of oversleeping! Third, always judge fairly! Fourth, always render a verdict before being driven off by both sides. — The Code of Gongpingge

skills.name: 拍击
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成魔法伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage to the enemy.

skills.name: 防御
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage taken by 70%; counters attacks.

skills.name: 借用
skills.description: 每回合随机变成己方队伍中其他精灵的技能。
skills.descriptionEn: Each turn it randomly becomes a skill of another spirit on your team.

skills.name: 天旋地转
skills.description: 造成物理伤害，先手+1，迸发：本次技能威力+30。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; priority +1; on Burst: this use's skill power +30.

skills.name: 伺机而动
skills.description: 下一次攻击时，技能威力+70。
skills.descriptionEn: On the next attack, skill power +70.

skills.name: 防反
skills.description: 减伤70%，应对攻击：自己获得物攻和魔攻+70%。
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage taken by 70%; when countering an attack: self gains Phys. ATK and Magic ATK +70%.

skills.name: 埋伏
skills.description: 造成魔伤，3连击，若敌方本回合更换精灵，本次技能连击数+3。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage; 3 hits; if the enemy switches spirits this turn, this use's hit count +3.

skills.name: 吞噬
skills.description: 造成物伤，若使用本技能击败敌方，回复6能量。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; if this skill defeats the enemy, recover 6 energy.

skills.name: 棘刺
skills.descriptionEn: The enemy gains 1 stack of the Thorns mark.

skills.name: 锐利眼神
skills.descriptionEn: The enemy gains Phys. DEF and Magic DEF -120%.

skills.name: 蓄能轰击
skills.description: 造成魔伤，每使用1次普通系技能，本技能能耗永久-2。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage; for each Normal-type skill used, this skill's energy cost permanently -2.

skills.name: 摇篮曲
skills.description: 敌方获得全技能能耗+3，应对防御：额外造成打断，且敌方下回合获得眩晕。
skills.descriptionEn: The enemy gains +3 energy cost to all skills; when countering a defense skill: additionally causes an interrupt, and the enemy is stunned next turn.
